findings.message: Scripts "build/three.js" and "build/three.min.js" are deprecated with r150+, and will be removed with r160. Please use ES Modules or alternatives: https://threejs.org/docs/index.html#manual/en/introduction/Installation

Frame 0 shows only the background, and the first frame is the thumbnail on social players: have the title or key image already on screen at 0 s instead of entering from nothing; see references/review.md.
This 41 s film has no sound source (no <audio>, no <video> with sound): add a music bed and sounds on the visible actions unless the person asked for silence; see references/sound.md.

Type floor is 28 px (2.6% of the 1080 px short side, what a phone can read) and 6 text elements stay under it for 0.5 s or more, the smallest "client site" at 26 px: set reading text to at least 28 px, or put data-layout-ignore on text that is texture rather than reading; see references/look.md.
